implementation: Original C++ sine-series/IFFT bank and biquad implementation; no browser code runs in the native process

waveforms.harmonics: 32 editable sine coefficients, index zero means fundamental; all-zero recipe stays silent
waveforms.normalization: Fixed peak of the complete sampled periodic recipe, independent of playing pitch; never normalize each band separately
waveforms.antialias: Three progressively truncated harmonic tables per octave, interpolated by instantaneous fundamental; no naive discontinuous square/saw sampling
waveforms.compatibility: Chromium-compatible bank sizes: 2048 at <=24kHz, 4096 at <=88.2kHz, 16384 above; these are implementation choices, not Web Audio normative requirements
waveforms.preparation: FFT and vectors allocated outside process(); immutable banks may be shared by future device hosts
limitations: Other browser engines and cross-architecture FFT differences unqualified
Table-bank preparation/cache memory is not a device CPU or memory qualification

filters.q: Legacy low/highpass use dB; bandpass/notch use linear Q
filters.denormals: Direct-form I output history below 1e-30 flushed to zero

gates.nativeSelfTest: 400 waveform/filter/rate/extreme profiles plus three v2 and three v3 maximum-route profiles, each at five block sizes

scope: Offline PCM identity, bounded state and block invariance only; no hardware output or human listening findings

modulation.contract: Execution plan v2, modulation block v1
modulation.processing: One-pole smoothing per route, stable route-ID sum, bounded offset then base addition/clamping; final oscillator frequency limited to Nyquist
modulation.parity: Original max 1e-4 / RMS 2e-5 PCM gates retained for all native v2 fixtures
modulation.corrections: Dynamic biquad requires direct form I input/output state; transposed state caused transient errors when coefficients changed. Exact Nyquist lowpass/notch identity and highpass/bandpass zero prevent cancelled-pole ringing.

historicalFailure.investigation: Chromium OscillatorHandler ProcessARate consumes the parameter span prefix for starts inside a render quantum. Initializing frequency removes the 440 Hz default transient; the connected pitch-control prefix still causes a phase difference. Keep the native deterministic source math and strict gate; correction remains open.
historicalFailure.resolution: Browser carrier now silently pre-rolls from a render boundary with phase-compensated Fourier coefficients and fixed original normalization. Native v2 also advances fractional-sample initial phase instead of rounding it away. Original failing musical fixture and unchanged gates remain.

modulation.qualification: benchmarks/native-parity-reference.json and benchmarks/onset-reference.json; full CI required

sanitizers.limitation: LeakSanitizer cannot inspect /proc/task under this worker sandbox; no leak-sanitizer pass is claimed

automation.curve: Up to six compiled absolute-time exponential points, before per-note cutoff modulation
automation.scope: Only patches already supported by the native profile; legacy sweep/tone/noise/drive/delay remain rejected

delay.signal: dry = 1 - mix*.4; send = mix*.55; wet = .8; stereo fractional-sample delay with feedback
delay.feedbackCycle: 128 additional frames per repeat, independently impulse-measured from the browser graph; native callback block size does not change musical timing
delay.ownership: 32 bounded shared buses per session; all ring allocation and destruction on control thread
delay.tail: conservative -100 dBFS bound includes feedback render-quantum latency at minimum 8 kHz
delay.qualification: 12 acoustic browser/native delay fixtures, shared buses, note-end tails, loop overlap, ended-note seeks and callback block invariance

drive.oversampling: 4x; two 2x Blackman-windowed sinc polyphase interpolation/decimation stages; same 128/256-tap definitions and 192-frame aggregate group delay as the browser reference
drive.curve: 1024 float tanh points with existing rounded strength and linear interpolation; canonical gain compensation
drive.preparation: immutable recipes shared per amount; all curves and coefficients generated on the control thread
drive.callback: fixed streaming histories, SSE2 baseline on x64, portable scalar path; no allocation, initialization, locks or blocks
drive.qualification: all 28 factory synth presets at 0 and fractional .010123-second onsets, three sample rates; unchanged max 1e-4/RMS 2e-5 PCM gates

legacy_movement.vibrato: existing delayed depth ramp, oscillator cents, .02s release of vibrato
legacy_movement.tone: additive cutoff LFO before octave modulation, .04s source tail
legacy_movement.tremolo: amplitude LFO before pan and delay send, .04s source tail
legacy_movement.browser_correction: initialize constant LFO frequency before source start without redundant automation; use phase-correct silent carrier pre-roll for legacy voices too
legacy_movement.noise_correction: interpolate the seeded float noise buffer at fractional sample onsets

samples.ownership: Decoded assets are immutable shared owners in a session; voices hold raw pointers into session-owned PCM; all allocation/reference retirement stays on control thread
samples.decoders: Symphonia 0.6.1 and statically linked Opus via symphonia-adapter-libopus 0.3.0; WAV/MP3/Vorbis/Opus/WebM/MP4 tested
samples.conversion: 64-tap Blackman-windowed sinc with 1024 phases on control side; linear sample playback and canonical 128-frame pitch control on callback
samples.bounds: 512 assets / 1 GiB decoded cache; source mono/stereo 8–192 kHz at this phase; 48 MB encoded asset; 301 seconds decoded
samples.parity: all 122 shipped assets, 16 sample presets, five complete examples, overlapping vocal Song, seek and loop
corrections: Accept shipped empty-extension PCM WAV fmt chunks without changing PCM
Honor MP4 edit lists for AAC priming and duration
Compile sample k-rate pitch curves to explicit canonical linear segments
Stop the session at an exact natural tail frame independent of device block size
